0.description: Felforged Battle of Hillsbrad now requires 20 kills down from 25.
Reduced cost of Felforged Temporary Mount Drastically
[Requires Restart] Felforged will now be unaffected by Twisting Presence
Legion Upgradeable Insignia is now given automatically for each rank of Fel Power rather than via the questchain
[Requires Restart] Fixed an issue where Felforged would not receive proper quest experience in Outland.
Fixed Grimoire of Demonic Power not giving the quest properly
[Requires Restart] Lowered the Felpower Requirement on Aptitude I to 100 from 250 to teach people about fel perks sooner.
[Requires Restart] Felforged Primary Stat setting will now be remembered between deaths.
[Requires Restart] Increased Hand of Fates received on death baseline from 3 to 5
Added tutorials to all Felforged NPCs on first introduction
Enabled Demonic Empowerment quests to obtain Mystic Orbs, Runes, and Skillcards as felforged.
Added better errors for why felforged and normal players cannot teleport to dungeons while in highrisk. You have to be in a rested zone while in highrisk to dungeon teleport!
[Pending Restart] Increased Auctionhouse cut to 7% from 5%, because this slight adjustment will begin to help reduce gold inflation.

6.description: G'eras' now additionally offers the following items in exchange for Badges of Justice: Band of the Crystalline Void, Ring of Conflict Survival, Yor's Revenge, Nexus-Prince's Ring of Balance, Shaffar's Band of Brutality, Yor's Collapsing Band.

[New] - TBC Raiders Commendations are now available from every boss in TBC raids on every difficulty. You can exchange these commendations at L'uta the Redeemer for Flex Normal Raid Gear. You can find L'uta near G'eras in Shattrath City.

3.description: Added missing 2019 and 2022 redistributables to launcher installer checks. (https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170)

6.description: [Pending Restart] - Bees will no longer spawn once a keystone ends and all bees currently alive will despawn once a keystone ends.

1.description: Fixed an issue where Resurrect coulds could not be drafted while a Battle Resurrect spell was known.
[Alar] Shield Slam (Shield Strike) now deals 25% reduced damage versus players, changed from 20%.
[Alar] Fire Blast now deals 35% reduced damage versus players, changed from 30%.
While in Bear Form, Searing and Magma Totem now deals 20% reduced damage versus players.

8.description: [Pending Restart] Denizens of Northwatch Hold in The Barrens (near Ratchet) will now be hostile to Alliance as they were to Horde, as part of the Ratchet scaling addition.

0.description: [Pending Patch Update] - Updated the tooltips of the high-risk enchants. Some enchants had an out-dated tooltip once enchanted on an item.
Added a tooltip to the Mentor buff to make it clearer what being a mentor means.

2.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where some level scaled mobs had non-level scaled followers / pets near Ratchet, the new faction neutral starting area.

0.description: Temporary player summoned guardians from spells can now critically strike with spells. This affects Fire Elementals (Shaman), Summon Water Elemental (Mage), Earth Elemental (Shaman) and Wild Imps from Hand of Guldan (Warlock).

[Pending Restart] - "Enraged Spirits of" Air/Water/Earth/Fire quests will now give credit to the entire group instead of to a singular player. These quests are a part of the Tempest Keep attunement quest chain.
[Pending Restart] - "A Lesson Learned" quest now requires 8 (down from 10) Ravenous Flager Eggs.
[Pending Patch Update] - Fixed an issue where some items were acting as "Unique" but are Unique Equipped! Items affected are as listed but not limited too: Light Fathom Scepter, Serpent Coil Band.
[Pending Restart] - Increased the drop rate of reptuation materials such as: "Arcane Tome" and "Fel Armament" from creatures in the open world.
[Pending Restart] - The Travel Permit can now take you to Ratchet (Faction Neutral) starting zone!

3.description: [Ascension TV] Solved issue where selecting a curated category would not update the "up next" playlist.

8.description: [Callboard Quest] - Crazed Colossus will now have a 3 minute base respawn time and will now also be subject to dynamic respawning. [More players in the area means that the mobs respawn faster].

6.description: [Pending Restart] - Changed the targetting logic of Apprentice Star Scryers. It will no longer randomly target totems (previously had a 20% chance to not target the highest threat target) with its arcane barrage (mainly hitting totems). It will now always target the person with the highest threat.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Power Word: Shield, Tidal Shield and Divine Aegis was affected by baseline healing reduction twice in arenas and battlegrounds.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Improved Imp was not increasing the damage of your Imps Firebolt.

[Pending Restart] - Wild Imps will now scale from talents that increase the imps damage or cast speed like Demonic Power, Unholy Power, Improved and Empowered Imp but will not be able to trigger effects like Demonic Pact and Empowered Imp.
[Pending Restart] - Wild Imps from Hand of Guldan now also scale from the owners intellect and stamina.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Wild Imps Firebolt had incorrect level scaling. This causes them to deal approximately 12% more damage at level 70.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the Wild Imps from Hand of Guldan was benefitting too much from spell power scaling, but was not benefitting from the owners spell power.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the Wild Imps from Hand of Guldan would not benefit from the owners hit chance.
[Pending Restart] - Backdraft will now reduce the cast time of Hand of Guldan.
[Pending Restart] - Demonic Influence will now also increase the damage of the imps summoned via Hand of Guldan.
[Pending Restart] - Master Summoner now increases the duration of the imps summoned by hand of Guldan by 2.5/5 seconds.
[Pending Restart] - Bane now also increases the critical strike chance and reduces the mana cost of Hand of Guldan.
[Pending Restart] - Molten Core now also increases the damage and critical strike chance of Hand of Guldan.
[Pending Restart] - Shadow and Flame now also increases the benefit of your spell damage for Hand of Guldan.
[Pending Restart] - The spell damage scaling of Hand of Guldan has been increased from 20% to 24%.

[Pending Restart] - The Base Damage of Hand of Guldan now has increased leveling scaling and deals approximately 23% more base damage at level 70 compared to the old values and approximately 6% more at level 60.

8.description: [Pending Restart] Ratchet quests and associated creatures will now scale from levels 1 - 20 (excluding a few quests normally above level 20). This opens up the possibility of Horde and Alliance questing together in a Neutral location from the beginning of your journey!
Fixed spelling errors on a few Path to Ascension: Journey to the Capital quests.
Replaced the missing Wanted: Hogger! signs that were missing.

6.description: [Pending Restart] - The auto-attack and ability damage from the Killer Bees (+7 affix) will no longer go through absorption effects like Tidal: Shield and Power Word: Shield.

0.description: The Underbog, The Arcatraz, The Botanica, and Shattered Halls corpse runner duration is increased by 12.5 seconds, 10 seconds, 15 seconds and 10 seconds.

6.description: [Pending Restart] - Completing a Mythic+ Dungeon now reward bonus Mythic Coins if the key level is the highest the holder of the keystone has ever done. The bonus is based on how many key levels ascended. For 1 chest completion timers you will earn 50 bonus mythic coins, 2 chest completion timers will earn a bonus 100 mythic coins and 3 chest completion timers will earn a bonus 150 mythic coins.
